mock_questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Equality?
mock_questions.explanation: Article 14 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Equality before law and equal protection of laws to all persons within the territory of India.
mock_questions.subject: Polity

mock_questions.question: The Directive Principles of State Policy are contained in which Part of the Indian Constitution?
mock_questions.explanation: The Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) are contained in Part IV of the Indian Constitution (Articles 36-51).
mock_questions.subject: Polity

mock_questions.question: Which of the following is the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats?
mock_questions.explanation: Arma Konda (also called Ammagonda) at 1680m in Andhra Pradesh is the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats.
mock_questions.subject: Geography

mock_questions.question: Who wrote "The Discovery of India"?
mock_questions.explanation: "The Discovery of India" was written by India's first Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru while he was imprisoned at Ahmednagar Fort during 1942-1946.
mock_questions.subject: History

mock_questions.question: Which Five-Year Plan in India was based on the Mahalanobis model?
mock_questions.explanation: The Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961) was based on the Mahalanobis model which emphasized rapid industrialization with focus on heavy industries.
mock_questions.subject: Economy
